entities.summary: Grand Duke Dmitri Pavlovich of Russia was a son of Grand Duke Paul Alexandrovich of Russia, a grandson of Tsar Alexander II of Russia and a first cousin of Tsar Nicholas II, Marie of Edinburgh, King George II of Greece, King Alexander of Greece, Helen of Greece and Denmark,, King Paul of Greece, and Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh.
